articles.title: Monday Wind on the Canal
articles.text: On Monday, the weather forecast warned that wind intensity would rise along the canal by noon. A woman in a red dress saw an open purse on a bench, but none of the boat passengers claimed it. The canal corporation could not dismiss the warning, so staff closed the exposed pier and tried to define the owner's route from ticket records. When the owner returned, she found both her purse and a safe indoor place to wait for the storm.
articles.translation: 周一的天气预报警告，运河沿线风力将在中午前增强。一名穿红裙的女子在长椅上看到一个敞开的钱包，但船上乘客都不认领。运河公司不能忽视预警，于是员工关闭了暴露的码头，并试图从票务记录确定失主路线。失主返回时，既找回了钱包，也找到了安全的室内地点躲避风暴。

articles.title: Why Fishing Disputes Grow
articles.text: A fishing dispute often begins when several boats frame the same bay as their traditional ground. Daily catch records contribute evidence, but crews must exchange data in a shared format; the fifth column cannot mean weight for one boat and value for another. Wind, a November storm, or a fisherman's cough may reduce effort, so raw totals need context to accompany them. Agreements become possible when people compare like with like and separate poor seasons from deliberate rule breaking.
articles.translation: 渔业争端常始于多艘船都把同一海湾视为传统渔场。每日捕捞记录能提供证据，但船员必须用共同格式交换数据；第五列不能在一艘船上表示重量，在另一艘船上表示价值。风、十一月风暴或渔民咳嗽都可能减少作业量，因此原始总数需要背景说明。当人们进行同类比较，并把歉收季与故意违规区分开时，协议才有可能达成。

articles.title: A Cinema Can Be an Emergency Shelter
articles.text: A coastal town may recommend its gym as an emergency shelter, yet an old cinema can offer thick walls, seats, and backup heat. The choice is not obvious: a fisherman arriving soaked may need dry space, while each kid needs toilets and a quiet corner. Planners must check flood maps so that water cannot submerge the entrance, and verify that no radioactive material or fuel is stored nearby. Using several buildings shares the burden and prevents a lack of one resource from closing the entire shelter system.
articles.translation: 沿海小镇可能推荐体育馆作为应急避难所，但老电影院也能提供厚墙、座椅和备用供暖。选择并不明显：浑身湿透的渔民需要干燥空间，每个孩子则需要厕所和安静角落。规划者必须检查洪水地图，确保入口不会被淹，并确认附近没有放射性物质或燃料。使用多栋建筑可以分担压力，也能防止某一种资源不足导致整个避难体系关闭。

questions.answer: Strong walls, seats, space, and backup heat.
